title: RBA Frets Potential AI Stock Slump Could Hit Australian Spending
key_facts: Internal RBA papers were released to Bloomberg.
A paper dated 1 Sep 2026 puts about 5.5% of household financial wealth in AI stocks, almost 90% of it in overseas companies.
A permanent 20% fall in AI stock prices would lower consumption about 0.7% in the long run.
The effect would be about 2.5% if losses spread to the wider equity market.
Staff said the figures may overstate the effect.
Bloomberg Economics estimates about A$510 billion of housing wealth lost since end of March.
